title: Accounts Administrator
description:
Accounts Administrator required to start on an immediate temp basis to join a busy and friendly finance team.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone with previous accounts administration experience, ideally with Sage 50 knowledge, who is available to start immediately.

The role is initially offered on a temporary basis, with the potential to become permanent for the right candidate.

Key Responsibilities:
- Processing purchase invoices, payments and financial data
- Matching invoices against purchase orders and ensuring accurate posting
- Managing supplier accounts and resolving invoice queries
- Chasing outstanding supplier invoices and credits
- Reconciling supplier statements
- Providing general administrative support to the finance team
- Reviewing purchase orders to ensure costs are correctly allocated
- Assisting with raising sales invoices
- Managing petty cash and associated transactions
- Liaising with internal departments to resolve financial queries

Benefits include:
- Basic salary up to 32,000
- Free parking
- 25 days holiday, increasing to 28 with service plus bank holiday
- Company pension scheme
- Private medical Insurance after 12 months of service
- Life insurance cover
- Income replacement insurance
- An employee discount scheme
- Cycle to work scheme
- Eye care
- Refer a friend scheme
- Team breakfasts
- Additional shift allowance for weekend and bank holiday work
- Training & development opportunities

Experience:
- Previous experience in an Accounts Assistant or Accounts Administrator position
- Ideally, previous experience using Sage 50
- Good working knowledge of Microsoft Excel
- AAT qualification or equivalent practical experience would be advantageous
- Strong attention to detail and accuracy
- Excellent organisational and time management skills
- Confident communication skills and the ability to work as part of a team
- A proactive approach with the ability to manage workloads and meet deadlines

Please bear in mind that you may not hear from us straight away. Due to the high level of applications, we receive every day, we can only respond to applicants, whose skills and qualifications are suitable for this position. If you would like to be considered for similar and future positions, or for a complete listing of all our current vacancies, please visit our website.

title: Accounts Assistant
description:
Our client, an established construction related business is looking to recruit a permanent Accounts Assistant to join their growing team in Epping.

Reporting to the Accounts Manager you will be supporting the day to day financial operations by managing accounts receivable, credit control, data entry, and maintaining accurate financial records.

Your proactive approach will ensure smooth financial processes, timely payments and reliable reporting. This position offers an exciting opportunity to develop your accounting skills within a collaborative and growth-focused environment.

Duties will include:
- Processing and verifying invoices using accounting software Sage and Insphire to ensure accuracy and timelines
- Managing accounts payable functions by preparing payments and reconciling vendor statements
- Entering financial data accurately into various accounting systems
- Assisting with bank reconciliations and monitoring cash flow to support financial stability
- Maintain organised records of transactions, invoices and receipts for audit readiness
- Support month end closing activities by preparing reports and ensuring all data entries are complete
- Collaborate with finance teams to resolve discrepancies
- Chasing debts

To be considered for this role, you will need:
- Proven experience with accounting software such as Sage is essential
- Strong data entry skills
- Knowledge of accounts payable and receivable
- Ability to work independently
- Previous experience in a finance or accounting role
- Credit Control
- Experience in CIS is desirable
- Confident using Excel

Due to the rural location of this role your own vehicle is advantageous.

Hours of work: Monday to Friday, 9am to 5pm.

title: Accounts Receivable & Credit Control
description:
Accounts Receivable & Credit Control Administrator
Location
Harwich, Essex
Job Type
Full Time Permanent
Salary
Competitive Salary + Benefits
The Opportunity
We are seeking an experienced Accounts Receivable & Credit Control Administrator to join a busy and supportive finance team. This is an excellent opportunity for a proactive and organised individual who enjoys building strong customer relationships while ensuring the timely collection of outstanding payments.
Working closely with colleagues across Finance, Sales and Customer Support, you will take ownership of customer accounts, manage credit control activities, and help drive continuous improvement across financial processes.
Key Responsibilities
Credit Control & Debt Collection
- Manage a portfolio of customer accounts and proactively collect outstanding payments.
- Monitor aged debt reports and identify overdue accounts.
- Build and maintain positive relationships with customers while resolving payment issues.
- Achieve collection targets and minimise bad debt exposure.

Customer Account Management
- Investigate and resolve customer account queries in a timely manner.
- Work closely with internal teams to support effective account management and customer satisfaction.
- Open new customer accounts and maintain accurate account records.

Credit & Risk Management
- Support credit reviews by gathering and analysing customer information.
- Assist with reviewing credit limits and payment terms.
- Liaise with external credit agencies and finance partners where required.

Invoicing & Order Support
- Process and monitor daily invoicing activities.
- Review orders on hold and communicate any actions required to relevant teams.
- Ensure customer account information is accurate and up to date.

Cash Allocation & Reporting
- Allocate customer payments accurately.
- Reconcile accounts and maintain clear account records.
- Produce regular reports to support finance operations and business decision-making.

Continuous Improvement
- Identify opportunities to improve processes and efficiencies within the finance function.
- Support colleagues across the finance team and provide cover for other finance activities when required.
- Contribute to a collaborative and high-performing team environment.

About You
To be successful in this role, you will have:
Essential
- Minimum two years' experience within Credit Control or Accounts Receivable.
- Strong understanding of debt collection processes and customer account management.
- Excellent communication and relationship-building skills.
- Good numerical and analytical abilities.
- Strong organisational skills with excellent attention to detail.
- Intermediate to Advanced Microsoft Excel skills.
- Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities.

Desirable
- Experience working with SAP or a similar ERP/accounting system.
- Knowledge of multi-currency transactions.
- Understanding of European VAT requirements.
- Experience working within a fast-paced commercial environment.

What We're Looking For
The ideal candidate will be a proactive problem-solver who enjoys taking ownership of their workload, building positive customer relationships, and finding ways to improve processes. You'll be a team player with a strong work ethic and a commitment to delivering excellent service both internally and externally.
Apply Today
If you're looking for your next challenge within a busy finance team and have a passion for credit control and accounts receivable, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Credit Controller
description:
Credit Controller Spider is advertising on behalf of Fuelogic, who are looking for an experienced, commercially minded Credit Controller to join their growing team in Kelvedon, Essex.

This is a full-time, permanent, office-based role, offering the opportunity to take ownership of a high-value customer ledger within a fast-paced business in the fuel industry.

Fantastic company benefits include:
- Salary:£30,000 £38,000 per annum, depending on experience
- Hours: Monday to Friday, 8.30am 5.30pm
- Working environment: Modern offices with a friendly, supportive and high-performing team

About the role

You'll take ownership of the credit control process, managing a substantial customer ledger, driving timely payments and balancing effective debt recovery with strong customer relationships.

Key responsibilities include:
- Managing a high-value ledger and proactively chasing outstanding payments
- Conducting credit checks, assessing financial risk and reviewing credit limits
- Monitoring aged debt, identifying high-risk accounts and escalating concerns
- Negotiating payment plans and resolving customer account queries
- Working closely with the Sales team to support commercial decisions
- Liaising with credit insurers and brokers regarding limits and overdue accounts
- Supporting the Head of Finance with credit risk management and maintaining accurate records

About you

You'll have significant credit control experience, ideally within a high-value, high-volume or complex ledger environment.

You'll be confident assessing credit risk, making commercially sound decisions and handling challenging conversations professionally.

With a firm but approachable telephone manner, you'll be comfortable chasing debt, negotiating payments and building positive customer relationships.

Strong organisational skills, attention to detail and excellent Microsoft Excel skills are essential, alongside the ability to work independently and take full ownership of your responsibilities.

Own transport is essential due to the office location.

About Fuelogic

Fuelogic operates within the fast-paced fuel industry, offering a supportive, collaborative environment where you'll play an important role in protecting cash flow and supporting continued business growth.

To be considered, apply through Spider with an up-to-date CV.

title: Finance Assistant
description:
Finance Assistant / Colchester, On Site / Salary £25,000-£30,000 (DOE) & Benefits

A growing, successful and well-established family-owned educational supplies business is looking to hire a Finance Assistant at their Colchester Head Office.

The role would be ideal for someone who is the early stages of their financial career or a recent graduate and is looking to gain experience in a hands-on role. This is an exciting opportunity to join a key company in the educational supplies sector that has a been at the forefront of the industry for over 50 years.

With a client base that exceeds 3,000 schools across the South East, HBS Group is focussed on continuing to strengthen their product offering which already spans over 15,000 products as well as optimising procurement operations and fostering innovation in product development.

Please note that this role is fully office based.

Key Responsibilities of the Finance Assistant:
- Support the day-to-day finance function and ensure accurate and timely financial administration.
- Process purchase and sales invoices, expenses and payment requests.
- Maintain accurate financial records and assist with account reconciliations.
- Assist with accounts payable and accounts receivable activities.
- Prepare and process supplier payments and resolve invoice queries.
- Monitor outstanding customer and supplier balances.
- Assist with monthly management accounts and financial reporting.
- Support month-end and year-end accounting processes.
- Reconcile bank, credit card and other balance sheet accounts.
- Assist with maintaining the finance system and ensuring data accuracy.
- Provide financial information and reports to management when required.
- Liaise with suppliers, customers and internal departments regarding financial queries.
- Ensure finance processes comply with company policies and relevant regulations.
- Support the Finance Manager with ad-hoc analysis and administrative tasks.

Skills and Experience Required:
- Good understanding of basic accounting principles.
- Strong attention to detail and numerical accuracy.
- Good organisational and time-management skills.
- Confident using Excel and financial/accounting systems.
- Ability to manage competing priorities and meet deadlines.
- Good communication and interpersonal skills.
- A proactive, reliable and collaborative approach.
- Ability to handle confidential financial information appropriately.

What s in it for you:
- Permanent full-time position
- Salary £25,000-£30,000 per annum (DOE) Plus Company Bonus Plan
- Statutory pension and 25 days holiday + bank holidays
- Free Parking and staff BBQ s
